verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a mesh VPN and network-connectivity platform. Installing Python packages with pip on a device is a package-management and runtime capability outside its category. Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale ships a Python runtime or package installer. SSH access to remote boxes only reaches the host's own environment and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install additional pure-Python packages using pip directly on my device
